asr.full_text: Hello hello and welcome to another update video on Avex. I want to take a quick look here at the Avex chart to determine whether we've bottomed here. Have we formed a local low or so? That's important because the price has reacted here to an important macro trend line of our price channel we've been tracking. And we've now reached the first resistance. Now I don't cover Avex too often on the first resistance. Now, I don't cover AVAX too often here on the YouTube channel. It's generally not too popular but I did ask you guys to leave your requests. If you have any on our X channel, I'll leave a link in the comment section and here you can obviously, you know, join, check it out. It's of course free. I'll leave a link in the comment section and in the pinned comment, you can drop requests. I'll read them all. I'll reply to them. I've covered a lot of them like avex yeah covered render pepe brenda tau and so on so yeah drop your requests here i'm just interested to find out especially in the beginning of the year what you guys are all interested in it doesn't need to be a crypto it could also be a stock here now if we take a look at the short term chart for avx10, you see that the move to the upside that we are tracking could form a 5 wave sequence. So the yellow pathway shows how a 5 wave move would look like. And the 5 wave move is extremely important, because 5 wave patterns are what constitutes a trend. So we need the five-wave move to get a good idea of what the trend is doing. With the three-wave move there is no trend. It's quite simple. It's nothing magic. But with three waves, you cannot get a series of higher highs and higher lows. It doesn't work. So we need that five wave pattern with the indication that the trend is shifting. It's important to recognize that at the moment we only have three waves. There are different ways how this could be labeled. I could also to place the wave two here, doesn't really matter so much. Importance is that we have now reached the first key resistance of of all those swing highs here we've reached the first one at around $14.70, $14.80 I'd say the entire area up to $15.30 is probably resistance and so there is this cluster of resistance here that we need to break next. What you can probably see here is that this forms something like maybe an inverse head and shoulder pattern and if we get a pullback from here ideally, we hold the 61.8 fib level, the golden ratio level at $12.89 to keep the local upside momentum intact that is possible inverse head and shoulders pattern but I don't even have nev there's no indication no evidence that a pullback even has started okay so that would be what i want to see next i want to see the structure of the next pullback and if we get a pullback then ideally it is a three wave move and ideally it would hold above the 12.89 level and then higher prices are possible from there. And then we can talk about it as a 5-wave move. And that would be, again, a wave 1. We can then add support for wave 2. And honestly, really only if we get this 1-2 set up, only then the, let's say, the third wave rally could come next. That would then be the, you know, it would open the door to the next rally. But I need to see five waves up first, because with only three, as I showed you, as I demonstrated, we don't really have that confirmation. We are shifting. We are turning around, right. So basically we are waiting here for evidence that it lowers in, and most important we want to see five waves for that, and then once we get the five waves, we can add support and have a 1-2 setup. So yeah, that's the update on AVAX. Hope you liked the update. If you did, please hit the like button, leave a comment, and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates, then check out our X channel. I'll leave a link in the comments section. Thanks so much. Bye-bye.
